sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The ASL covers HB-620 at PLT-PIN for CUST-NOR (only SUP-H is currently approved) but has no entry for SUP-E. The SUP-E audit status does not approve it for any part (QP-11 4.1).

sources.quote: A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before the first shipment.

findings.why: HB-620 belongs to PRG-Y (Nordhavn). A new source needs written Nordhavn approval before the first shipment. Nothing in force covers it.

The drawing requires MAT-ALSI9CU3 and the porosity special characteristic SC-HB620-POR applies. SUP-E is an electroplating coater with no material capability for MAT-ALSI9CU3 or any die casting. Only SUP-D and SUP-H have that capability.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: No 3.1 certificate from SUP-E for MAT-ALSI9CU3 is on file. The SQE (PER-GALLO) needs to be asked.
